paragraphs.text: The Edemi Island Chain is a collection of islands off the coast of central Madara .
The two most important of those islands were Argenti and Kusho . The islands never truly accepted Madara's rule over them, and rebel every decade or so.

During the Madara-Edemi War , the islands saw heavy conflict and many deaths. Although both Kusho and Argenti were all but conquered by the invading kentsu , the combined efforts of Tetsuo Umezawa , Ayesha Tanaka , Tor Wauki the Younger and the Edemi defenders Magnus , Ohabi Caleria , Gosta Dirk and Kasimir ensured that the islands prevailed through the war.
